requirement: A phone photo stored on its side is measured upright and cut to the crop's shape, never stretched

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: a 1200x900 orientation-6 JPEG cut for 16:9 used a 900x675 (4:3) region stretched to 640x360
oracle.invariant: S1: orientations 6 and 8 give 900x1200; 1 and 3 give 1200x900. S2: the cut is 640x360 and the region taken (rect) is 16:9 within 1%, inside 900x1200.
